name: Worldforged Rosebud Ring in Ashenvale sits at its reachable realm-dump spot instead of on the cliff (#13242)
contract: #13242 reported the Rosebud Ring pickup (Ring of Druidic Whispers, gameobject entry 90389, guid 6942102, drops item 450860) in Ashenvale at an unreachable height. The realm-map pass moved it 22.94 yd north-east to the 2-digit map pin (2788.900, -1529.000, 282.281), 18.64 yd higher on a 71.6 deg cliff face. rev_20261126_13242 restores first-pass realm-dump row 6900940 (2781.930, -1550.850, 263.640) on flat 0.6 deg terrain (261.817) beside Kalidartreestump02.m2 (whose visual root geometry is not in VMap collision, so spawn_ground_gap reads +1.82 yd above terrain; do not assert spawn_placement). Expected: the pickup stands at (2781.930, -1550.850, 263.640), is not under water, and opens with loot from flat ground 2.33 yd away (24.7 yd from the broken cliff spot).
